_comment: Perk catalog for `dnd-cli loot roll` and `loot force`. DRAFT: GitHub issue #1. A perk is a prefix or a suffix on a weapon or an armor. `rarity` is the lowest item rarity that can roll it. `weight` is the roll weight. `effect` is the id of a preset in dnd_cli/effects.py, or null. When `effect` is null, the DM must rule the perk: `ruling` says how, and `needs` names the new effect type that would let the engine apply it. A perk that is not in this list stays free text. Common and legendary items get no rolled perk. See combat-board.md, section 7.

perks.ruling: Weapon: +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls. Armor: +1 AC.
perks.needs: a flat bonus to attack, damage or AC

perks.name: Keen
perks.ruling: A critical hit on a natural 19 or 20.
perks.needs: a change to the critical range

perks.name: Blessed
perks.ruling: While the item is used, the wearer has Bless (+1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws). It needs no concentration.

perks.name: of Warding
perks.needs: a flat bonus to one kind of save

perks.name: of Flame
perks.ruling: On a hit: +1d6 fire damage. The blade can light a fire.
perks.needs: extra damage dice on a hit
